def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # normalize island label variants (case + trailing spaces)
    df['island'] = df['island'].astype(str).str.strip().str.capitalize().replace({'Nan': None})
    # body_mass_g written as text with commas -> numeric
    df['body_mass_g'] = pd.to_numeric(
        df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '', regex=False).str.strip(),
        errors='coerce')
    # flipper_length_mm: coerce to numeric, fix sign errors (negatives), enforce valid range
    fl = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'].astype(str).str.strip(), errors='coerce')
    fl = fl.abs()  # sign errors like -215 -> 215
    fl = fl.where((fl >= 170) & (fl <= 235))  # out-of-range -> NaN
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = fl
    # other numeric columns coercion for safety
    for c in ['bill_length_mm', 'bill_depth_mm', 'year']:
        df[c] = pd.to_numeric(df[c], errors='coerce')
    # drop rows missing the key measurement or group key
    df = df.dropna(subset=['species', 'flipper_length_mm'])
    return df

def answer(df):
    d = clean(df)
    g = d.groupby('species')['flipper_length_mm'].mean()
    return {str(k): float(v) for k, v in g.items()}
